Kubera
śaiva. Upāgama in Vijayāgama. See list in Kāmika.

Kubera
eponymous a. of Ubhayālaṅkāra according to Kāvyamīmāṁsā of Rājaśekhara, GOS. edn. p. 1.

Kubera
authority mentioned in Saṅgītamakaranda (p. 13. GOS. edn.) of Nārada. See V. Raghavan, ‘Some Names in Early Saṅgīta Literature’, J. of Music Academy, Madras, III. p. 20; Sangeet Natak Academy Bulletin 5.

Kubera
--Bhairavasvarṇākarṣaṇastotra. Udaipur p. 100, no. 1129 of Pt.. Cat.

Kubera
great grandfather of Bāṇa Bhaṭṭa (a. of Kādambarī).
(Śrīkṛṣṇatantra mentioned in title is the last topic). See Col. kuberaracitA ceyaM bAlAnAM hitakAriNI | dIpiketi samAkhyAtA zodhyA sadbhiramatsaraiH || Triv. Cur.

Kubera
(Sāndhivigrahika) ins. poet. Ganjam plates of the Rājan Netṛbhañjadeva alias Kalyāṇakalaśa, son of Raṅgabhañja of Orissa. Ed. Epi. Ind. XVIII. p.. 295-6. See Bhand. Ins. of N.

Kubera_upādhyāya
dh. Q. by Raghunandana in Śuddhitattva (Serampore edn. II. p. 144) an. Śrāddhatattva (Serampore edn. I. p. 183; Jivananda edn. Vol. I. p. 298). See JASB. (NS) XI (1915) p. 365; Kane, HDS. I. p. 686. [Page198-a.

A. D. (Kane, HDS. I. p. 686).
--Dattakacandrikā, on adoption.

Kuberapati
--Tīrthasudhānidhi. based on Up.. an. Purāṇas.
Pt.. Benares, 1879. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1876-92. 197.

Kuberapurāṇa
or nalAyana in 100 Sargas containing 4724 verses. by Māṇikyasūri.

Kubera_śarman
Kāñjibilvīya.
--C. composed in 1685 A. D. on Śatānanda's Bhāsvatīkaraṇa. Hpr.

Kuberānandavarṇin
--Ātmavivecanikā. adv. Baroda 758. Wai 198.
--Dānabhāgavata, styled paurāṇika. dh. a voluminous compilation based on Purāṇas composed under Saṅgrāmasiṁha; q. Bopadeva.
of 1887-91. 496 of 1886-92. BORI. D. II. i. 352 (a fr. dealing with philosophy of Śabda). Udaipur p. 58, no. 208 of Pt.. Cat.

Kubja
Ins. poet. a. of the Talagunda Pillar inscription of Kākutsthavarman. Epi. Ind. VIII. p.. 31-33.

Kubjātīrthamāhātmya
Pt.. in the compilation Tīrthayātrānirūpaṇa by Balirama Sarman, 1920. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1402.

Kubjāmrakamāhātmya
part of Māyākṣetramāhātmya (Gaṅgākṣetramāº). from the Kedārakhaṇḍa of the Skandapurāṇa.

Kubjāśiromaṇi
tantra. Q. in Dakṣiṇāmūrti's Uddhārako1śa (Lahore edn.

Kubjikā(mata)tantra
Kubjikātantra is q. by Abhinavagupta, an. a ms. of Kubjikāmata (Nepal I. p. 54) was copied about 1080 A. D. an. a ms. in Gupta characters has been found; different versions of Kubjikātantra are known. The original is said to contain 24000 ślokas in four ṣaṭkas of 6000 ślokas each. See Nepal I. preface lxxviii-lxxxi; also Yearbook,

Kubjikātantra
tantra. in 9 Paṭalas. in the form of a dialogue between Pārvatī an. Parameśvara. Beg. devadeva mahAdeva paradeza purAtana. Different from the texts noted above. RASB. VII.

Kubjikāpūjāpaddhati
a manual of the Western school of Tantra. in prose an. verse; contains many stotras on Śiva an. Śakti. Nepal II. p. 80 (inc.).

Kubjikāmata
one of the sixtyfour Tantras mentioned in Vāmakeśvarīmata, Kas. Texts 66, p. 16.

Kubjikāmata
from Kulālikāmnāya. See Kubjikātantra also. Nepal I. p.. 8 (inc. in Newari script). 11 (2 mss.; one called Ṣaṭsāhasrikā). 34. 53 (called Ṣaṭsāhasra) 54. 55 (Text called Caturviṁśatisāhasra, copied in 1035 A. D.). 57-8. 98 (150 verses an. called Sārdhaśatikā). 99. (25 Paṭalas). Nepal II. p. 152 (56 Paṭalas). RASB. VIII.
-1900, p.. 4-6 (4 mss. all copied in 12th Cent.). [Page200-a.

Kubjikāmatottara
from Kulā(v.)likāmnāya. Nepal I. p.. 7-8 (inc.).

Kubjikāmantra
mantraśāstra. TD. XX. Sup. no. 899 (q).
. The col. calls it Ku. mata for which see the entries above.

Kubjikāsarvasva
tantra. Q. by Dakṣiṇāmūrti in his Uddhārako1śa. C..
